$comment: Custom (manual) models for providers whose gateway-side model list is a
static, image-baked list with no live discovery. Applied by
apply-custom-models.sh through POST /api/provider-models {provider, modelId,
modelName, source: manual, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, supportsVision};
an id the gateway already holds is left alone (re-run = no-op).
WHY (2026-10-12, read from the gateway image sources): OmniRoute 3.8.50 ships
xiaomi-mimo and xiaomi-mimo-token-plan with only mimo-v2.5-pro and mimo-v2.5
(open-sse/config/providers/shared.ts), no entry in PROVIDER_MODELS_CONFIG and no
registry modelsUrl, so GET /api/providers/<id>/models answers source
local_catalog (intentional) and model sync imports just those two. The synced
catalog is authoritative, so mimo-v2.6-* answers 400 'not available in the
active live catalog'. A custom model is an explicit operator override that the
authoritative catalog does not exclude (src/sse/services/model.ts lookupModelMeta).
PROVIDER: the Token Plan key lives on the connection of provider xiaomi-mimo
(base URL overridden to the AMS token-plan host in the connection's
provider_specific_data), so the rows target xiaomi-mimo, not xiaomi-mimo-token-plan.
Numbers: context and output are the vendor's v2.6 figures (1M context, 128K =
131072 max output; mimo.mi.com model table, 2026-10-12). supportsVision follows
the vendor's 'full-modal understanding' for v2.6; the registry capability flags
stay 'unproven' until a live call proves them (fixes-L2-mimo smoke).
Retire the v2.5 ids from routes after 2026-10-21 (vendor retirement).

openrouter/free: the OpenRouter free-model router. It answers 200 through the gateway but is not in GET /v1/models, so model-list consumers (OWUI sync) flag it (fixes-L1 D-1199). No limits declared: the router picks the underlying model.
No mimo-v2.5-* model is declared (operator, 2026-10-12: legacy; the gateway's static v2.5 list is not wired to any route and mimo-v2.5-asr/-tts are not declared).
